text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan aggressively aims for the 
front! Now, who will burst out from the 
third corner?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: *gasp*!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(You don't even give me a second to 
breathe, do you? ...Keeping your eyes 
solely on 1st place.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha... To be honest, this is way harder 
than when we fought for the Derby...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (—I know why that is.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
—Because Ryan-chan has spent all this time 
polishing herself in the world of racing.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Even while I was wavering around, both in 
the Arima Kinen and the Tenno Sho 
(Spring), she just kept pursuing her own 
running style.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(So this is the strength born from 
carrying expectations all this time...!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! But. Even I――

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (I'll give it... everything I've got...!!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...! Haaah~...!!
(Woooooaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: —Kh. Hah... ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(More and more, faster than anyone else―― 
I want to be able to sprint like that...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if you were watching, too.

text_block_list.name: Spectator in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
...That was a great run. Ines! That was an 
awesome run!!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Manager
text_block_list.text: Whew! Didn't you do great!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you so much for cheering 
today! Please keep supporting me going 
forward!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(D-Dang it... I meant to say it right 
after we finished...!)
(Woooooaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Did I manage to live up to their hopes, 
though? Did my run today become a dream 
for everyone to share?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ines, you really do love running after 
all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer! I want to make everyone 
happy in our next race, too!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What kind of race should I enter? Trainer, 
what do you recommend?!

Even after returning to the waiting room, 
her excitement hadn't cooled down. 
However, our strategy remained unchanged 
from before.
choice_data_list:
What kind of race do you want to run in, 
Aines?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Eh...? A race I want to run in? Let's 
see... Hmmm.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, I'd like to hear what 
kind of races everyone would be happy to 
see me run in...
choice_data_list:
In that case, it should be a race you can 
have fun running!

In that case, it should be a race you can 
have fun running!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Whaaat?

Ines Fujin tilted her head in confusion. 
Deciding to let her rest for today, I 
resolved to set our goals another day.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
"The descriptions regarding adjacent 
property relations are... wait, this is 
too haaard! I shouldn't be reading this on 
my breeeak!"

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ines~! Starting from the afternoon 
today~? Nice to be working with ya!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yup, lookin' forward to it~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Hey, hey, what kind of race do 
you want me to run in next?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Since I've got this chance, I was 
thinking... I'd really like to run in the 
races that all my supporters want to see 
me in!

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Any of 'em's fine! Wait, Ines, you're 
racing again!? Tell me the second it's 
decided~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh!? You think so? Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn), Queen Elizabeth II 
Cup, Mile Championship, Japan Cup...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
There are so many GⅠs in the fall~! Would 
taking on distance races give people 
courage? Or maybe if I took on races 
filled with prestige...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Ines, you sure are agonizing over 
this.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ryan-chan! How did it go? What were the 
test results?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
They found inflammation in my leg. Said I 
need to rest it. Still, I plan to make a 
speedy recovery!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
More importantly... Ines, what race are 
you running next? Since we're here, let me 
know!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah... I just can't decide on it at all.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I want to run in a race that'll make 
everyone happy, but I have no clue which 
one would be best...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Well, what if we flipped our 
thinking around?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Instead of asking which race makes them 
happy, how about thinking about how *you* 
want to make everyone happy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“Just kidding. Ehehe... I sounded a bit 
full of myself there, didn't I?”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...! No, that way of thinking might 
actually be good! As expected of 
Ryan-chan, you're so dependable!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I want to run in the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone has traveled so far to cheer me 
on up until now, like at the Takarazuka 
Kinen and the Asahi Hai FS, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So I was hoping maybe you'd come cheer for 
me casually at my Tokyo races every now 
and then~

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"It seems to be a stage where you compete 
in speed, and running in it looks like so 
much fun!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Is that too simplistic of a reason? 
Should I be thinking about some 'grand, 
noble cause' instead?"
choice_data_list: No, let's take on the Tenno Sho (Autumn)!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, sweet♪ Trainer's totally on board 
too!

"Her desire to run" is the foremost 
condition for choosing a race.

"I'm sure she'll run just as freely in the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn) as well."
